rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Because this place is definitely not home.
rows.speaker: Demetri

rows.text: Mom and Dad told me that the children of Kremnos are born to wield swords and fight on the battlefield.
rows.speaker: Demetri

rows.text: They also said that the {RUBY_B#Kremnoan army in exile}Kremnoan Detachment{RUBY_E#} led by the crown prince is the bravest army across all of Amphoreus. No one can defeat them!
rows.speaker: Andriskos

rows.text: The kids in the holy city don't play with us. The moment they find out that our parents are Kremnoans, they shun us...
rows.speaker: Marsyas

rows.text: But we don't care. We all know that the crown prince will take us home one day!
rows.speaker: Marsyas

rows.text: That time has not yet arrived, but... Young men of Kremnos, heed my command! Return to your parents at once. From hereon, you are to dedicate yourselves to rigorous training and a healthy diet. You must not neglect these two aspects if you are to become a brave warrior of Kremnos.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Only by following this path can you be deemed worthy of returning home.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Yes, Your Highness!
rows.speaker: Castrum Kremnos Children

rows.text: (The future of Kremnos... I should find Krateros.)
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: (There he is. Is he engaged in a debate with that foolish lion?)
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Drat! It's the crown prince of Castrum Kremnos...
rows.speaker: Distressed Soldier

rows.text: Get a grip! We're here by order of the Council of Elders. Even the Chrysos Heirs have to think twice before doing anything to us.
rows.speaker: Scouting Soldier

rows.text: Out of my way, lackeys of the Council.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Uh...
rows.speaker: Distressed Soldier

rows.text: Th—The Civil Guard of Okhema is on official duty. Please keep out of this area!
rows.speaker: Scouting Soldier

rows.text: Calm down, my lord. Play nice...
rows.speaker: Verax Leo

rows.text: Don't make me repeat myself.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: I—I'll allow you to pass this time... but just this once!
rows.speaker: Scouting Soldier

rows.text: So, you think yourself knowledgeable? Then here is a question for you: Do you know how Chryseus Leo in Castrum Kremnos came to be mounted on the wall?
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: I—I don't know, my lord, ahaha... How did it come to be?
rows.speaker: Verax Leo

rows.text: Hahaha! Let me enlighten you. A long time ago, the founder of Castrum Kremnos led a group of warriors to hunt down a lion on the outskirts of the city of Tretos.
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: That vicious beast had been a menace for years, and the bones in its den were stacked even higher than the peaks around Okhema.
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: But do you know what happened? Nary a moment had passed after the beast's head peeked out of its den when the Kremnoan warriors surged forward and brought it down within the blink of an eye, shattering its knees with a single strike! And then—
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: ...Why are you red-faced already? We haven't even gotten to the best part yet!
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: I—It's your storytelling, my lord. You're weaving such a captivating tale that it got my blood pumping. Please, go on...
rows.speaker: Verax Leo

rows.text: — Well, well. If it isn't Lord Mydei! It's been a while, ahaha...
rows.speaker: Verax Leo

rows.text: Oho, what in Okhema is happening?
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: To what do I owe the pleasure, son of Gorgo?
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: Krateros... My esteemed teacher.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Let's talk somewhere else, Mydeimos. I'm tired of speaking with this silly lion.
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: What about the Council's informants?
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Those two hyenas are nothing but scavengers of rotten meat. They couldn't bite even if they tried.
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: They can follow us if they want to. Let's go.
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: Wait, so how in the world did Chryseus Leo get mounted on the wall!?
rows.speaker: Verax Leo

rows.text: Keep up with us, you hyen... oh, sorry, I meant officers.
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: Hey, old man, how dare you—
rows.speaker: Scouting Soldier

rows.text: Calm down, calm down!
rows.speaker: Distressed Soldier

rows.text: Seems like the son of Gorgo has a poor sense of direction, huh?
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: Don't fall behind now... unless you want to upset our friends here.
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: D—Don't you dare try any tricks with us...!
rows.speaker: Distressed Soldier

rows.text: We're almost there.
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: Eurypon, {RUBY_B#Mydei}the boy{RUBY_E#} did nothing wrong!
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: This is murder! Do not sully the noble name of Kremnos with the blood of an innocent child! You mustn't reveal your weaknesses to the enemy!
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: Enough! My decision is final. We must use this child's life to preserve the soul of the great {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: We must... save Castrum Kremnos.
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: Don't be absurd! Those tiny hands lack the strength to even lift a spear! Do you truly believe him a threat to Castrum Kremnos!?
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: You'll be ending the bloodline of Kremnos if you do this. Our millennia-old glory will become nothing more than a joke!
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: Have you forgotten that we Kremnoans place no value in bloodlines? It is through {RUBY_B#Kremnos Festival}pure bloodshed and slaughter{RUBY_E#} that the kings of Kremnos have ascended to the throne...
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: As for our millennia-old "glory"... it has always been a joke in my eyes. Glorify it all you want, but it will not alter the nature of slaughter. Those who revel in it are but murderers. They are no more noble than the most monstrous beasts in Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: Enough with your words! Among all the kings of Kremnos, which one did not inherit the crown only after plucking it from the lifeless body of his father?
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: But listen to yourself now! Do you truly believe you can cleanse the blood from your hands through mere words alone?
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: Nay, quite the contrary. I will end this cycle of bloodshed...
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: ...Starting with this child. With these bloodstained hands, I will end it all.
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: Your failure is inevitable, Eurypon! You are just a coward who can only raise his blade against his own child! A beast that murders his own kin!
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: King's Aegis and Ephors of Kremnos, you cannot sit idly by and watch this atrocity unfold! If you consider yourselves the honorable sons and daughters of {RUBY_B#Kremnos Founder}Gorgo{RUBY_E#}, then take up your spears and join me in putting an end to this bloody charade!
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: ...Does anyone else have any objections? If so, come forward with your spear and prove your mettle!
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: ...Understood.
rows.speaker: Magistrate

rows.text: Five...
rows.speaker: Magistrate

rows.text: Four...
rows.speaker: Magistrate

rows.text: Three...
rows.speaker: Magistrate

rows.text: No one dares stand by my side? Cowards! Has that crown stripped you of your courage!?
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: Two...
rows.speaker: Magistrate

rows.text: One.
rows.speaker: Magistrate

rows.text: It appears there are no objections. Then, in accordance with the Kremnoan Council's principle of tacit consent, the decision is final.
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: With all present as witnesses, this child shall descend into the Sea of Souls, where he will nourish the {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Lance of Fury{RUBY_E#} and join the fallen heroes.
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: May fate and the gods await your arrival...
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: My son... Mydeimos.
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: Stop!
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: If you have more to say, then speak. On account of the life we have shared together, I grant you this one final chance.
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: With the Blade of Fury above us and the Council bearing witness, I, Gorgo, hereby move to challenge the crown in accordance with the laws of Kremnos!
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: O unworthy king, in the name of the Council of Elders, I demand that you duel me!
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: Heh... Very well.
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: We shall see who the Kremnoan blade strikes down.
rows.speaker: Old King Eurypon

rows.text: Mydeimos, my son...
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: They all tell me to forget... But how could I ever?
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: The son of {RUBY_B#Kremnos Founder}Gorgo{RUBY_E#}... will be crowned in blood.
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: If there is no Kremnos without the crown... then I shall seize the crown and smash it to pieces to bring the people to their senses.
rows.speaker: Gorgo, Mydei's Mother

rows.text: The mother roared in anger.
The armies remained in silence.
Only the cries and the waves of the Sea of Souls echoed.
{M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer], you're awake.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I apologize for arriving uninvited. I saw that you were still asleep, so I took the liberty of waiting nearby.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I bring a message from Lady Aglaea. She has prepared a gift for you and Dan Heng, and wishes to present it to you in person.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I'm glad you're in good spirits. Alright, let's set off.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The baths are bustling. Now that {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} has fallen, the soldiers in the city can finally catch a break.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Is that... Lady Tribbie and Lady Trianne?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: You must have forgotten! This is a precious relic from our hometown! We definitely all saw it back then!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Trianne, this is a counterfeit. We both know it's impossible for something this fragile to have survived all those years in one piece...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Nothing is impossible! We are fragile, too! But we still got through those... those sad times. Look at that color... and how it glitters in the light... It's exactly as we remember it!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Why won't you buy it? If someone else gets to it before us, we'll... we'll miss our chance forever...
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Calm down, Trianne... You need rest.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Please, there's no need to fret. If you need more time to make a decision, I can put this aside for you until tomorrow... or until you're ready.
rows.speaker: Merchant

rows.text: No, no, it's alright. Trianne is just... She'll come to her senses tomorrow. We'll be off first.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Trianne is just what? Trianne is super mad, that's what!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: You've forgotten... You've forgotten all about Mama! Mama gave us something just like this before!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Trianne...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Uh... See you tomorrow? I hope you two patch things up soon...
rows.speaker: Merchant

rows.text: See you tomorrow. May the winds of fortune bless you.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: It's so hard to understand what they're thinking sometimes...
rows.speaker: Merchant

rows.text: The authenticity of the piece isn't important. What matters is that it holds special meaning for Lady Trianne and reminds her of her hometown.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I've long wished to show my gratitude for Lady Trianne's care, but I haven't been able to come up with any ideas for a suitable gift. This chance encounter today feels like divine intervention. Perhaps this is the gift I've been searching for.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Still, this trinket is admittedly rather fragile. I will have to make some adjustments and stitch it onto wool felt to protect it. That way, no matter how much Lady Trianne runs around, it won't break easily.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Alright, back to business after that little detour.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: So, we have no way in?
Is the Grove closed to visitors?
What an inconsiderate Titan!
Let's keep moving. Don't stray far now — we've already kept Lady Aglaea waiting long enough.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: It seems your friend arrived before us.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: You're finally here, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Welcome, Cas. And you as well, Trailblazer from beyond the sky.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You're up so early, Dan Heng!
I didn't expect you to call me that.
The gift! Gimme the gift!
Then let me ignite my creativity... Ummmm...
Actually, I have some Solid Water.
You would've been, too, if you hadn't stayed up so late. But what matters is that you got a good rest.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Your companion here kindly explained the meaning behind the name to me earlier.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Through him, I've come to understand that you and your friends walk the paths of {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#} and Janus in places beyond the sky. Addressing you appropriately is the least I can do as a show of respect.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...I'm sorry about my companion's behavior.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Not at all. It's good to see [Trailblazer] bouncing back with such energy after that tough battle.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: For all that has happened, it was never our intention to drag you two into the battle against {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} and jeopardize your safety. To express our gratitude for your kind Trailblazing endeavors, we would like to present you with the highest honor of Okhema.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: This is the Dew of Divine Blood, brewed from crops nourished by the blood of the Titans. It is said that only twelve bottles existed. The last three bottles are now being kept in the treasure vault of Okhema.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Back in the days of prosperity, cities fortunate enough to acquire it regarded it as one of the greatest treasures ever. Unsealing it during a ceremony held in honor of two cities' diplomatic ties was the highest form of respect one could show the other.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: And now, in keeping with tradition, Okhema dedicates this drink to our esteemed guests from beyond the sky in appreciation of what you have done for us.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: My hand is trembling under the weight of this gift...
I'm not of drinking age yet.
...The Express has house rules about drinking, and even I'm not exempt to them.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This precious gift isn't simply a token of gratitude though, is it, Lady Aglaea?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You're up so early, Dan Heng!
Very perceptive, Mr. Dan Heng. Your heroic deeds have proven that you come in good faith. With the Dew of Divine Blood as testament, we wish to forge an alliance with the Trailblazers.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I didn't expect you to call me that.
Your companion here kindly explained the meaning behind the name to me earlier.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Through him, I've come to understand that you and your friends walk the paths of {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#} and Janus in places beyond the sky. Addressing you appropriately is the least I can do as a show of respect.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: The gift! Gimme the gift!
With all due respect... won't forging an alliance with the Chrysos Heirs embroil us in the conflicts within Okhema?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm sure you can understand where our misgivings come from, Lady Aglaea.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Right, we need to think about this first.
Waaaah, my gift! My gift...
...Wow, you seriously took a liking to the gift.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Having said that, Lady Aglaea, please don't misunderstand, we will still do what we can to assist you in the Flame-Chase Journey.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: My hand is trembling under the weight of this gift...
I'm not of drinking age yet.
It's just... I've heard of the friction between the Chrysos Heirs and the Council of Okhema. As outsiders, we are wary of getting caught up in this conflict—
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Wow, Grayie and Dannie have sharp eyes indeed! You'd make outstanding members of the Twilight Courtyard!
No need to worry, by the way. I can tell from Lady Aglaea's tone of voice and micro-expressions that she's being genuine.

Not only are you guests from beyond the sky, but you've also done so much for Okhema. You're practically heroes to us all! Lady Aglaea would never subject you to {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila's{RUBY_E#} judgment.
Hmm? You are...?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Right, we need to think about this first.
Waaaah, my gift! My gift...
Hyacine. Thank you for taking care of the wounded over the past few days.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: It's no trouble at all! The patients are very cooperative when we attend to them. I'm just thrilled to see them all going home healthy again.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: And ooh! It's Cassie! I've missed you!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: This girl... She's a natural at making friends.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hehe, as an acolyte of {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila{RUBY_E#}, I'm here to bring healing light to the world. Plus, I've heard you're also children of the distant skies! Fate must have brought us together!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Can we be friends? I'd love to hear your tales of the sky! And ooh, it's a rare occasion that Okhema presents such an invaluable gift to guests. Lady Aglaea, may I have the honor of tasting it, too?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Of course you may. Esteemed guests of Okhema, please believe me when I say that this gift carries no hidden agendas. As for the matter of the alliance, you need not give me an answer here and now.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...I see. In that case, we will accept this gift from Okhema. We welcome the chance to talk with you, Lady Hyacine.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yay! Then I'll get started on my questionnaire!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Let's go.
I'm ready, too.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Okie-dokie! Everybody, let's hold hands! To the Grove we go!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: You might not be aware of this... but using the Century Gate takes a significant toll on Lady Trianne.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Are we not using the Century Gate?
Mm-hmm! Trianne promised Tribbie that we wouldn't open the gate unless we had no other choice!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Hang on a minute.
The Grove is far! It's important to be ready!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: A few days later, Grove of Epiphany

Pardon the question, but I've been meaning to ask this for a while: micro-expressions, tone of voice, questionnaires... Are these all part of the usual skill set for {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila's{RUBY_E#} priests?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Allow me to do the honors. This young lady is Hyacine, assistant lecturer of the Nousporists at the Grove of Epiphany and head nurse at the medical institution known as the Twilight Courtyard.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Many of the Chrysos Heirs suffered injuries during {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}'s attack on Okhema, so the Grove sent Lady Hyacine to treat the wounded in Okhema.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: But what I'm really good at is helping people sort out what ails their mind and spirit. If you're ever feeling troubled, come find me! A little sunbathing in the courtyard will chase all your worries away!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: How are you two so close already?
Cas and I are now good friends after traveling together for so many days!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: It's hard not to like Mem when they're so adorable.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Sure.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I wanna try, too.
You go first! I'll cheer you on!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Ah, so you're a therapist. Thank you, we will keep that in mind.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Well, it looks like everything's sorted out now! The patients have also all recovered. I think it's time for me to head back, Lady Aglaea.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: This shows that I'm learning new things! Once I obtain the memory of poking wool felt, will I grow hands that are as pretty as Cas' hands?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Scary. Don't teach her how to sew, Cas.
Hehe...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: That just sounds weird.
I would love to keep you in Okhema for a few more days, but I would hate to provoke the ire of the Grove.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: As it happens, Okhema intends to send a messenger to the Grove for updates about the research on the black tide. We also want to communicate our desire to discuss the retrieval of {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces'{RUBY_E#} Coreflame at the earliest convenience.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: That... sounds pretty serious. Lady Aglaea, you can't be asking me to...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You'll learn a powerful new ability!

A giant tree bowed slightly in the silent forest, tilting and falling into the wilting green waves. A passing breeze rustled through the leaves, as if it was sighing, softly fading into the lightless ocean above on high.
Would March 7th appreciate this sublime scene? You're uncertain. Dan Heng, perhaps...
Never mind, every time he encounters a tree as big as this one, it would be a deeply troubling situation.
Take a photo of this big tree.
(I never fail to impress... This photo deserves an award!)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: What is this huge tree, though...?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: It's the {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Bough of Rift{RUBY_E#} — the divine body of Cerces. Flora began to grow where they planted their roots, and this flatland basin upon which we stand gradually became a large, verdant forest.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: A long time ago, Thalesus, the First Scholar, led the masses to build a garden and courtyard in the forest, naming the site the "Grove of Epiphany." There, people sought mental clarity, knowledge, and enlightenment.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Trianne knows this! Everybody says that was how this big academy came to be.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: But... is the academy supposed to be this quiet?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: The Grove has always welcomed scholars. So too would {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#} give us her delicate leaves and extend her branches in greeting.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Something feels off...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Yet... it seems both the Grove's messengers and the Titan are indifferent to our arrival.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: So, we have no way in?
There should still be a way in. I'm just... a little surprised.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Is the Grove closed to visitors?
That doesn't seem likely... Miss Hyacine didn't mention anything about it.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: What an inconsiderate Titan!
Um... Please don't speak such words once we're in the confines of the Grove.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Maybe everybody's still asleep because classes haven't started yet! They don't want to be disturbed, so they shut the entrance.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: For now... let's look around and see if we can find out what's happened.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: No need to fret. We won't put you on the spot. Trianne will be going there as the diplomatic messenger of Okhema, and Castorice will be accompanying her.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I happen to have a few questions for Professor Anaxa as well, regarding the missing Titan {RUBY_B#Death Titan}Thanatos{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Since this involves Okhema's diplomatic affairs, we'll give you some privacy.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Maybe Aglaea didn't give them a heads-up?
There is no way she would have neglected such an important diplomatic matter.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Maybe... something happened?
Hm... That's possible.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Maybe they really are asleep?
That's not very likely... As far as I can recall, the voices of people engaged in debate echoed throughout the Grove at all hours of the day.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Helloooo? Is anyone thereeee?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Is this some kind of ritualistic prayer?
If you're not keen on just sitting around, [Trailblazer], why not go with them? The Grove is a picturesque place, perfect for sightseeing.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Whoa, that scared me!
What should we do now?
Should we head back?
Whoa, that scared me too!
Come now... Don't give up so easily! At least struggle a bit like a scared bunny!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: ...I have an idea. Lady Trianne, could you lend me that golden spindle?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Do you remember? Lady Aglaea said this: "While you're in the Grove, the golden thread of the Weft can also render all things around you visible, regardless of whether they're corporeal or not."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: This is achievable because the Grove is not only where the roots of {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#} are... but also where the Chrysalis of Gold manifests.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "O {RUBY_B#Romance Titan}Mnestia{RUBY_E#}! With the Weft as my vow, I beseech you: Entwine my body with your golden thread and affection!"
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Ah, I'm sorry... I had to recite that chant so that the golden thread would resonate with the Titan's presence within the leylines.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: This is... a proverb that was recorded in the handbook of Mnestia's priests.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Who came up with this? How... unique...
Well... These lines are documented in the handbook of Mnestia's priests, so...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: If I'm not mistaken... we should be able to draw power out of this butterfly exuvia with the golden thread.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: That's a wonderful suggestion! Come visit the Grove, Grayie! I'd be delighted to show you around!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Sounds good. Gaining more insight into the customs and geography of different regions of Amphoreus is also part of Trailblazing.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: In that case, do bring this spindle along with you.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: This tool, called the Weft, is used to spin thread and has been passed down in my family through generations. Though it doesn't see much practical use nowadays, it's become a symbol of great significance. In this respect, it is the perfect token to represent my will. If you encounter trouble at the Grove, just take this out and show it to them.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: While you're in the Grove, the golden thread of the Weft can also render all things around you visible, regardless of whether they're corporeal or not, allowing you to see things as I would. Castorice knows this, too.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: No, it isn't a White Dryad...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: However, this also means that the golden thread has definitely connected with the Titan's presence. Without the golden thread's outlines, we would not have been able to see them at all.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Make good use of it. Trianne is already waiting for you at the outskirts of Okhema, so I won't keep you any longer. May your journey be smooth.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I'm glad to be in your company again, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Tell me about the Titan known as Thanatos.
Who is Professor Anaxa?
What is the Grove of Epiphany?
{RUBY_B#Death Titan}Thanatos{RUBY_E#}... controls my fate, in a sense. The curse I bear came from them.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: And they have something of mine... something of great importance that I must get back from them.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Got anything?
Almost...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: This looks... really scary...
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: What kind of... beast is this? Or is it the Death Titan's Kin?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: No, it's neither of those...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: This is a creation of the black tide. Such creatures are formed when living beings are corrupted and turned into deformed, hollow husks of their former selves.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Everybody, stay alert. Regardless of what has happened to the Grove, the fact that we're seeing the remains of a black tide creation here definitely doesn't bode well.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Ah, wait...!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Should we... should we inform Agy about this?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: That... black thing... seems to be moving?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Th—The monster is alive! Trianne will protect everybody...!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: ...Trianne, please hide behind us.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer], let's do this.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: When I was studying at the Grove alongside Phainon and the others, Professor Anaxa was responsible for teaching us about the Chrysos Heirs and the Titans. That's also when I met Miss Hyacine... She was Anaxa's teaching assistant then.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The Grove of Epiphany is Okhema's partner academy. They look after the Coreflame of {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#} and are the organization at the forefront of researching phenomena such as the black tide and the Titans. They also provide academic research support for the Flame-Chase Journey.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: To think the black tide has spread this quickly to the Grove despite its remote location...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I'm afraid a world where Strife has fallen is far more dangerous than we ever imagined.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Several Chrysos Heirs are based in the Grove, including Miss Hyacine and Professor Anaxa.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I don't have any more questions. Let's go!
I came here with a colleague from the Twilight Courtyard. I've asked her to pack her luggage in advance, so she's already waiting for us by the city gates. Let's go meet up with her!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: At the same time, in Okhema
Lady Aglaea, after a few days of surgeries both major and minor, we were able to save the life of that patient found on the outskirts of Okhema.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Look, there she is... and Lady Trianne! But who's that they're looking at?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Did something happen, Clementine? Ah... that's a serious injury!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Miss Hyacine, this man was—
rows.speaker: Clementine

rows.text: ...Was discovered by Trianne! Trianne was in a baaaad mood this morning, so we went to the outskirts of Okhema for some fresh air... b—but then we found him collapsed on the roadside!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Trianne knows the city has good doctors! So Trianne brought our new friend into the city to look for a doctor!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: ...I was waiting here for Miss Hyacine when I bumped into Lady Trianne. By then, this man was already in critical condition... so I had to perform some emergency treatment first.
rows.speaker: Clementine

rows.text: Now that I think about it, Castorice and the rest should have arrived at the Grove by now.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Ah! Trianne just got in contact!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: These wounds... They're caused by the black tide!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: This is bad... Clementine, prepare a ward for this man at once. I'll treat him myself... It's a miracle he's still alive, considering how badly the black tide injured him.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Grayie, Cassie, and Trianne. Would you mind making your way to the Grove first? Once this man is out of danger, Clementine and I will join you.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: As a healer, I cannot ignore those in need of medical attention.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Can they tell where the Coreflame is right now?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I understand. May fate have mercy on this poor man.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Trianne believes he'll get better!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Everybody, follow Trianne! Fly, fly, fly away from Okhema!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: But... they can't say for sure whether the Titan has also been corrupted by the black tide.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Down this road we go! To the skies we fly! Leaving Okhema behind!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Please let them know that for now, the most pressing task is to identify the Coreflame and transfer it to a safe place as quickly as possible. We must also search for survivors and find out exactly what happened to the Grove.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Little Cas, Little Gray, are you ready?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Hm...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I pray for their safety, too.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Is this... a joke as well?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: They may have even prepared the gallows from which to hang us already.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Alas, it's too late. The Council will likely take this opportunity to do something... I will try to keep this under wraps for now, but you must also take care and be prepared for anything that may happen.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...We can only hope that the Grove weathers this crisis with as many survivors as possible.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: It's harder than I thought to sew gemstones onto wool felt...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Cas has such nimble fingers. I want to learn too...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Hehe, Mem wants to try sewing? Here, why don't you give it a go?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: This is amazing... It seems as if their voice has become more intelligible after the battle with {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: After spending the last few days together, I feel like I'm gradually gaining the ability to understand what they're saying... even if it's just a little.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: That's horrible! You can't say that to a girl!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: I was just kidding! Anyway, I believe that this trip to the Grove of Epiphany will definitely be a fruitful one.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: How exciting... I wonder what changes I'll experience next?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Phew... Is everybody awake? Little Gray, Little Cas, and... a little pink puppy?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Think about it: There are so many memories scattered all over this world! Surely at least one contains an image of Trianne's mama?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Woven Trail... Where did it get its name from?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Legend has it that whenever they requested an audience with Cerces, {RUBY_B#Romance Titan}Mnestia{RUBY_E#} would always come to the meeting in a long white dress. As the warps and wefts of the dress came into contact with the ground, they turned into paths and stairs...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: May this romantic path bring good tidings to Okhema.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Look, a huge tree! It's... huge!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Lady Aglaea doesn't "trust" Anaxa at all, I'm afraid.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Ah... That makes complete sense...
Believe me, she is far nicer to the two of you than she is to Anaxa.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: He sounds like a big shot.
Hm? Were you in a similar situation before, friend?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Despite being a Chrysos Heir, Anaxa resolutely believes that Titans and prophecies are a load of nonsense.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: During our regular citizens' assemblies, he always votes to oppose the Flame-Chase Journey.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Huh? And he's still able to conduct research here? Didn't you just say that the Grove is an academy that was established around a Titan?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Trianne knows the answer to that! Everybody says that {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#}, who symbolizes reason, is the most tolerant of novel ideas. Apart from {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#}, they're the Titan who treats us the best.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Well, it looks like {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#} must really be open-minded if they're accepting of even this kind of novel idea.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Yes, that is how we formed an agreement with these Titans who bear no harm toward humanity. If they agree to support us on our Flame-Chase Journey, we will wait till the final moments of the journey to restore their Coreflames.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...With the exception of {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}, that is. They didn't lend us their power willingly.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: I don't think {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#} was as reluctant to help us as you put it, or they wouldn't have deemed [Trailblazer] worthy and allowed me to journey alongside all of you!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Trianne believes {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#} will be alright! After all, everybody says that the people of the Grove are really smart.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Good idea. In that case, please bring the Weft along with you, Lady Trianne. The golden thread will be much more effective from up above.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: That is true. It's also fortunate that these gods weren't corrupted by the black tide and did not descend into madness...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: So, Little Gray and Little Cas, just leave the task of finding Anaxa and everyone else to Trianne! It's easy for Trianne to look for people because we can fly!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Please promise us that you'll take care of yourself.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Okie-dokie! If Trianne gets in trouble, we'll look for all of you. In return, if you get in trouble, remember to call for Trianne, okay? We'll come right over and open the Gate for you!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: That's the other thing I wish to mention: Do not open the Gate unless you have no other choice, Lady Trianne. Your body is... not in good shape at the moment.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Ah... Okay, we will keep that in mind. Trianne was just trying to help...
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Of course we know that. After all, Lady Trianne is a demigod, the most powerful among all of us here.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Remember all those brave heroes in the tales you've heard? They would always save their strength until the very last moment. That way, they could ensure that nothing went wrong with their plans. Isn't that right?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Mm-hmm! In that case, brave Trianne shall clear the way for all of you!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Wow, it's so majestic! [Trailblazer], hurry up and capture this moment!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: This place is too quiet... What in the world is going on?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Trianne found it! Everybody, fly across to the other side!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: There's no keyhole in this door...
Yes, most of the doors on Amphoreus are sealed using the power of {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Save your energy. {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#}'s power... is far stronger than we could ever imagine.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Flaming lance, forward!
The entrance on the other side... Where could it be?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Little Gray's eyes are so sharp!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: I knew you would find it. The Courtyard of Storge should be just ahead of us.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...As I expected, something's not right here.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Even though we're not scholars, someone should've come forward to receive us by now...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Not to mention that this whole place is also eerily quiet.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: No one's here!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Ahh, there isn't a reaction... Did it not work?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: But that shouldn't be...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Eh? Everybody, look over there! Something's appearing...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Is that... a White Dryad?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: White Dryad... What a cute name.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: No, it isn't a White Dryad...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: It is the shadow of a dead White Dryad.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Dead White Dryad...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: ...Shadow?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Strictly speaking... these white dryads are still plants. They only gained sentience as a result of {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#}' blessing of equality, but their sentience is minimal when compared to that of humans. These flowers have already died... What you see here are just faint afterimages of their souls.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: However, this also means that the golden thread has definitely connected with the Titan's presence. Without the golden thread's outlines, we would not have been able to see them at all.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: As the golden water lily touches the amber, flames spill from its petals.
Curiously, the fire does not consume the entire flower. Only faint sparks gather at the tips, subtly burning.
But... what happened to them? Why are there only tiny shadows of them left?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Mem, can you read their memories?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let me try. Mem... memem...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: I'm afraid that someone's probably nearby. As we are unable to ascertain whether they are friend or foe... we better remain cautious.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Oh... Trianne will be on high alert!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: The smell of Death... is becoming more and more intense.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: There... On the steps.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: That's why you're supposed to keep quiet in a library.
Y—You defeated it! Little Gray, Little Cas, you're so strong...
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Don't be afraid, I have experience in ghost hunting!
But these monsters... They aren't supposed to show up here, right?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: To think the black tide has spread this quickly to the Grove despite its remote location...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I'm afraid a world where Strife has fallen is far more dangerous than we ever imagined.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The heart?
Oh no... Does this mean that Okhema is also in danger?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: The air?
Looking at this mess... it seems the scholars at least succeeded in fending off the first wave of attacks.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: White Dryads?
But... at what price?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Lady Aglaea, after a few days of surgeries both major and minor, we were able to save the life of that patient found on the outskirts of Okhema.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: A statue resembling an old man draped in robes, seated in deep meditation...
...resembling an old man, draped in robes, seated in deep meditation, and capable of singing.
(Stare at the statue)
(Stroke the statue)
(Knock on the statue)
Thank you again, Hyacine, for your hard work.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Whoa... Who's there!?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: The scarring of his organs was especially severe, a result of the black tide's corruption... It's a miracle he's even survived. I can't say for sure when he'll regain consciousness...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: What a good-looking ghost.
What a smooth-talking child... I'll accept your praise.
Ha! Demon, eat my bat!
What an impatient child... Don't you know that haste makes waste?
...Who are you? Keep your distance and identify yourself. Otherwise, you'll face the consequences.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Don't stress yourself out over this. You've already done everything in your power to save him. There's no need to hurry to the Grove either. You deserve a good rest now.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Tribbie, I have some things to tell you as well... There's something strange about where that patient came from.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: A giant waterwheel. It looks like it can turn, and it can actually turn. If the waterwheel could turn right now, it would be a sure win. It's a pity that it can't be turned for the time being.
The answer is "water" — without it, the waterwheel cannot turn.
He is not Okheman. The way the stitches on his clothes are hidden is quite unique... Such craftsmanship is undeniably from the Grove.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Consider it done.
It's simple, I'll just have to turn it.
I can't do it...
Indeed... You can only do so much by yourself.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Can you... really do it?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The pure white girl gazed at you with a subtle expression, while the pink creature's large eyes held a hint of curiosity. And that ghostly woman appeared unwilling to open her eyes.
The Grove? You mean...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Now that I think about it, Castorice and the rest should have arrived at the Grove by now.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Then let me ignite my creativity... Ummmm...
You hold your breath and focus. Drip drip! A drop of water falls into the pool.
Huh... Can that really work?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...No, it was merely an ordinary drop of dew, following the natural laws of water's three states, not born of inspiration.
It seems like it won't be possible to fill it up with just the few of us...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Actually, I have some Solid Water.
You placed a piece of solid water, and it quickly dissolved without a trace.
A futile effort. Yet your fervent hope to revive this great tree was so intense that some presence from the distant multiverse cast an approving gaze upon you.
It seems like it won't be possible to fill it up with just the few of us...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Ah! Trianne just got in contact!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Mmm...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: The black tide has invaded the Grove...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: We haven't detected any survivors, even with the help of the golden thread... Wh—What should we do, Agy?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: ...The black tide is posing an even greater risk to us now. I did not expect the Grove to be the first to be impacted, though.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Mmm...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: We see it... The Coreflame is still there, but...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: But what?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Ah...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Oh, and... find Anaxa. Unless something went terribly wrong, he should still be alive.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: They've set off. Please, stay safe, everyone...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: I pray for their safety, too.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Agy... how do you know that Anaxa is still alive?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: I know that man all too well. If that blasphemous "performer" knew that he was not long for this world, he would most certainly try to seize the Coreflame and drag the Titan down with him.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Is this... a joke as well?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: No, I'm being serious this time.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: We're facing threats from both within and without Okhema. The {RUBY_B#Chrysos War}merciless carnage{RUBY_E#} may have ceased, but Okhema's nemeses continue to sharpen their blades even now...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: They may have even prepared the gallows from which to hang us already.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You mean...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Even if the divine authority of Strife is as yet unclaimed, the black tide is advancing more rapidly than expected... I fear this tragedy is more than a mere natural disaster.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Alas, it's too late. The Council will likely take this opportunity to do something... I will try to keep this under wraps for now, but you must also take care and be prepared for anything that may happen.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Alright. Should I... inform Hyacine about this?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Not for now... She must be exhausted after performing surgeries non-stop for so many days. I don't want to overwhelm her with this bad news.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...We can only hope that the Grove weathers this crisis with as many survivors as possible.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: That being said, based on the condition of this patient, Tribbie, we should prepare for the worst.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...It's likely he is the only one who managed to escape from the Grove, against all odds.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Everything will be fine! The people at the Grove are really smart. They'll definitely be able to chase away the black tide!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Aglaea said that Anaxa is still alive. If that's true, then there's still hope for everyone else too...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Who is this Anaxa anyway? Why does everybody seem to have some kind of trust in him?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: How should I put it...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Lady Aglaea doesn't "trust" Anaxa at all, I'm afraid.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Little Trianne is so motivated... I mustn't fall behind!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: I'll use something to help all of my friends that only I have: {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}'s power!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: I wonder if I'll find any memories.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: So many monsters...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Maybe I'll find some useful memories here... Let me try.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: I can't open it... It was probably sealed in order to ward off the black tide.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: There's no keyhole in this door...
Flaming lance, forward!
Yes, most of the doors on Amphoreus are sealed using the power of {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Save your energy. {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#}'s power... is far stronger than we could ever imagine.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Since this door is a creation of the Three Titans of Fate, maybe the eyes of {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#} will help me find a way to open it...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Are you serious? Just a mere door, and your first instinct is to call on the gods?
Memi...!?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Before you try unlocking the door, perhaps you should first find a way to clear the fog that clouds your vision.
You scared me! Are you... the echoes of a memory?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: My name is Anaxagoras, one of the Seven Sages of the Grove of Epiphany and the founder of the Nousporists. Before we go any further: Rule number one, do not call me Anaxa.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Anaxago... Anax... Ugh, I'll just stick to Anaxa. Now, can you tell me—
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Is the room too cold?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...That's a complicated question. I'm not sure I can answer that.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Rule number two: Never interrupt me. Silence is golden.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: What a difficult person!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: And what might your concerns be, my friend?
rows.speaker: Merchant

rows.text: Uh... I suppose I can sell it to you at cost as a sign of goodwill, Miss Castorice. Just promise to support my business in the future!
rows.speaker: Merchant

rows.text: I... Fine. I'll sell it to you at cost as a sign of goodwill, Miss Castorice. Just promise to support my business in the future!
rows.speaker: Merchant

rows.text: Much appreciated.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The person standing here and conversing with you right now isn't the vestiges of a memory. Rather, it is the culmination of the greatness of science and the pure, irrefutable, and undeniable exalted truth.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Through the wonders of alchemy, I have shattered my soul and transmuted it into gold before burying it in this spot. I have recorded these words so that visitors may learn where their next destination lies.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: You might not be aware of this... but using the Century Gate takes a significant toll on Lady Trianne.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Sure.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Mm-hmm! Being adorable isn't enough. I need to be strong, too!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Do you like cute little animals that much? ...Are you secretly the type that cares a lot about outward appearances?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Wah, you don't have to yell!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Alchemy can do that?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Nothing is impossible. Having said that, alchemy is not omnipotent. Each time you hear from me, an equivalent part of my soul is being consumed as the price. In other words — this voice isn't created out of thin air.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: It's just a figure of speech!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Um... Please don't speak such words once we're in the confines of the Grove.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Maybe everybody's still asleep because classes haven't started yet! They don't want to be disturbed, so they shut the entrance.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: There is no way she would have neglected such an important diplomatic matter.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Hey! Don't say it together with me! You're distracting me!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: But how is it that you can respond to me...? Are you really the echoes of a memory?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: That's because my precise calculations account for every possibility. I also know that you have already discovered the cause of the calamity at the Grove — the black tide — and that you mistakenly believe that the scholars have been wiped.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: But that is where you're wrong: While the black tide was still approaching the Grove, the sages found a way to evacuate the vast majority of the scholars. They are heading toward the holy city of Okhema as we speak.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: ...You don't have to take that too seriously. For some reason, he's especially particular about his full name.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Professor Anaxa theorizes that all beings originate from the same source and have a similar composition, which in this case refers to the soul. He calls this theory Nousporism...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Yes, that seems like the only good news so far. We can just focus on retrieving the Coreflame then.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I... do not wish to consider this possibility.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Only a small fraction of the scholars stayed behind with me to defend the Grove. If all goes well, {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#}' Coreflame will reach Okhema before long...
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: What an impatient child... Don't you know that haste makes waste?

...But since you have accessed this message, something unforeseen must have occurred. For now, you should continue onward to the Luminary Throne where you may retrieve the Coreflame... and our mortal remains.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Professor Anaxa? That's a lot to digest at once... I'm sorry, please give me some time.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Of course not. Just ask the fair lady beside you. She'll definitely know the reason why.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Normal? Gosh, what a pity.
Courageous! Then, how "Trailblazing"?

You move one foot back, brace yourself, and lower one shoulder while supporting the slab with the other. Once steady, you repeat your technique, placing both palms beneath the slab. With a sudden surge of strength, you channel all your power into your shoulder and hands—
Indeed... You can only do so much by yourself.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: "Trailblaze," it's "Trailblaze!" You remember whenever in trouble, keeping "Trailblaze" in mind has always guided you through adversity. You once even toppled an almost nascent Aeon with it. A mere waterwheel is trivial by comparison.

Exactly, this is how it should be done — no, how it can only be done! To destroy all obstacles... It's your art where "Destruction" and "Trailblaze" intertwine. This is the reason you are the Galactic Baseballer and the protagonist of Legend of the Trailblazer!
Once spoken, words are irrevocable. As the Kremnoans would often say, "the word 'joke' does not exist in the Trailblazer's dictionary."
...I'm not.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Truly a rare sight to behold.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Indeed. Could it be that you actually do not know how to proceed?
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Heh, you're making it sound so ominous.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: The Luminary Throne? What sort of place is that? Why would there be a throne in an academy?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Hey, the door can finally be opened! It seems like that message also served as a lock.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: ...If only THEY could interfere in the affairs of the Titans.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Alchemy is truly... incredible.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "Happiness abounded in this lush land by gods chosen..."
Hm...
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Mmm... A good question.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Mmm... A good question.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Oh... Straight to the point.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: That's no good... You asked two questions.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Wh—What's that sound?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Heh heh, also, the spindle that Agy gave us is so powerful that Trianne seems to have found Nax...
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Yup! The spindle that Agy gave us is so powerful that Trianne seems to have found Nax...
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: "Air supremacy secured!" ...That sounds so cool! But what does it mean?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Huh...?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Oh, so you found a survivor! But the golden thread doesn't seem to be able to sense the person you're talking about.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Oh, so you received help from a kind-hearted person! But the golden thread doesn't seem to be able to sense the person you're talking about.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Whoa! A spirit... Trianne wants to meet this spirit that even the gold thread can't sense!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: There's no one here... Did I just imagine that singing?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Even in the native myths of Amphoreus, it all boils down to "sincerity brings miracles." Show genuine intent, and the butterfly will surely respond...
With your extensive experience in dealing with little creatures, you are certain the butterfly will not ignore you—unless it can resist the urge.

Understanding the common nature of human society, you believe that the drive to compete is an innate instinct of all living beings — surely the butterfly is no exception — and that vying for shared prey should awaken this primal urge deeply embedded in its genes.
...Let me give it a try.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: No, you didn't imagine it. I heard it as well.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Friend, you're too humble! In that case, I'll just have to settle for being second best while Cas can be the best.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Oh, right! Sorry, I forgot about Trianne.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: I'm glad that everyone is alright. Speaking of which, this piece of amber is...?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I'm afraid that someone's probably nearby. As we are unable to ascertain whether they are friend or foe... we better remain cautious.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "Giants raised their glasses in a toast beheld by the twelve constellations..."
(I never fail to impress... This photo deserves an award!)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's that voice again! This time, it's coming from...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Aren't they just the cutest nicknames? Hehe.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Um, Miss Hyacine, about that nickname... Could you—
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Hehe...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I'll let you take it from here, then.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...I have no clue where it's coming from. There's too much echo in this library!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Haha, you're mistaken! The capable Lady Aglaea doesn't need my help with things like this.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: That's why you're supposed to keep quiet in a library.
That's right, let's do our best to buy time for {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Don't be afraid, I have experience in ghost hunting!
Now, in your private bath chamber
Ever since the battle with {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}, you haven't slept so soundly in ages.
Even if Death itself came to rouse you, you'd proudly retort: Why does life slumber? Because the bed is warm...
Yet, a chill from the River of Souls wafted by, a sensation hauntingly familiar. Could Death truly be at your door?
Best to open your eyes, just in case...
I know! Also, I wasn't even the one singing...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Why do you even have experience in that...?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: ...Found it.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The voice is coming from... over there.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The heart?
The air?
White Dryads?
How can a heart possibly speak — and it's not even lit up! I think that something supernatural must be at play here...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: How can the air possibly speak! I think that something supernatural must be at play here...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: White Dryads... Shadows of dead white dryads just like before?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: No, it seems to be coming from somewhere even further that way...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let's go check it out.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: S—Slow down. We don't want to alert them.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Ha... Regardless of what you do, a stone won't be able to speak.

Thanks for helping me out. I'm not one to venture out often, and while I have some savings, it takes a lot out of me to even talk to people, let alone haggle... Had you not been here, I would've been set back plenty.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Hehe... Such a lively little bunny. You even smell a little familiar.
...Who are you? Keep your distance and identify yourself. Otherwise, you'll face the consequences.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The scent of {RUBY_B#Death Titan}Thanatos{RUBY_E#}... I recognize you. Aidonia's renowned Goddess of Death.
Since you are aware, stop provoking the authority of Death. Answer my question.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Be careful, [Trailblazer]... Even if the head of the Lotophagists has never shown their true identity before, we shouldn't trust this person so easily.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: This heart is the source of all water in the Grove...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Indeed. When the sparks of inspiration burst forth within the Grove, dewdrops fall and land within the pool.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Heh... Just come with me.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: We must first retrieve a treasure if we want to awaken the heart.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Why did you suddenly freeze? Do you have another way to make the water wheel turn?
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Is that the... "Chamber of Purifying Tears"?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: You have a good memory.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: ...Why exactly did you bring us here?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: My intentions should be obvious...
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: See that shallow pond over there? Water lilies grow there. Initially, {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#} watered them with their tears while Mnestia nurtured them with affectionate love. They are a token of the eternal companionship between the two gods.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: All the two of you have to do is to cross the deep well and retrieve the Golden Bough of Vows for me.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: ...Cal, you're making things sound too complicated. All you want us to do is to retrieve the flower, right?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: We can retrieve it, but I advise you not to waste your time on any schemes.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Oh my, I'm helping you to eliminate your worries and obstacles, and yet I receive nothing in return?
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Besides, the bough is essential for awakening the heart and drawing water out of the source. If you can't find it this time, we can just remain trapped here for the rest of eternity.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: What's that supposed to mean!? Are you planning to keep us here forever?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Heh, you're overthinking things. We're all in the same boat.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Although, it would be absurd to say that I have no other motives. Since you've brought it up, I might as well take this chance to explain...
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: I'm simply making use of this opportunity to see what you two are made of. So, is that truthful enough for you?
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: See what we're made of... Could you have phrased that any more directly?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Now is not the time for me to elaborate further. So, please proceed?
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: As a student of Anaxa, "equivalent exchange" should be something that you are familiar with.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: ...I cannot deny that.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: What is this huge tree, though...?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: But... is the academy supposed to be this quiet?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: The Grove has always welcomed scholars. So too would {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#} give us her delicate leaves and extend her branches in greeting.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: [Trailblazer], since our interests are aligned right now, it's better for us to do as she says. Besides, she knows about my past... Even though I'm not able to elaborate much, I can tell you that she has reasons to fear me.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: If you unfortunately turn out to be her ultimate target... Please don't worry. I will promptly intervene.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "Black"... "Cloak"... and "Sword"...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: "Toward the Great Tree"...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Uh... That's it. Their memories are too faint for me to see anything. I could only vaguely make out these words.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: ...I have a bad feeling about this.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The deathly fog of {RUBY_B#Death Titan}Thanatos{RUBY_E#}... is fast approaching.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Everybody, stay alert. Regardless of what has happened to the Grove, the fact that we're seeing the remains of a black tide creation here definitely doesn't bode well.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Ah, wait...!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: It's so reassuring to have Cas around. I should put my brain to use too, then.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Hm? The time dimension revealed by the orb shows... water lilies growing there.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Let's hope that this is not a trap set by her...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Heh, so lustrous and beautiful... It's even more magnificent than before.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: There's a secret passageway behind the pond. It's faster if we take that path.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: ...How do you know this place so well?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Well... I'm one of the Seven Sages after all.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Now, can our little goddess perform that again?
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Heh, it's just... an ancient promise between the Titan and humans.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Well, it's your turn now, little goddess of Death.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Alright, go ride the water wheel. I'll wait for you up there.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Believe me, she is far nicer to the two of you than she is to Anaxa.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I don't think {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#} was as reluctant to help us as you put it, or they wouldn't have deemed [Trailblazer] worthy and allowed me to journey alongside all of you!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Trianne believes {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#} will be alright! After all, everybody says that the people of the Grove are really smart.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Good idea. In that case, please bring the Weft along with you, Lady Trianne. The golden thread will be much more effective from up above.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Eh... So, you don't actually have to take the water wheel?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Speaking of which, don't you also have a red-haired companion?
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Seriously... Exactly how much do you know about us?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Hehe, not too much. It's just that I seem to hear the sound of a bee buzzing around.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Lady, your metaphors... are not worthy of praise at all.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Phew, finally! Some fresh air!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Brr... But the wind feels so chilly...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: He's near the treetop! Even though our perception of him is very weak, it's not like the White Dryads from before.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Cal, come and meet our other companion!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Ugh, the golden thread is vibrating more and more violently...
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Everyone, let's be even more cautious.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: There's no one... Hold on, the Butterfly of Divine Mind is gone?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: That can't be. Was it for fending off the black tide, or perhaps...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: What exactly is this "Butterfly of the Vine Mine"? Is it a very powerful guardian monster?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: No, how should I put it... It's considered a safeguard for the Titan's Coreflame. This butterfly is created from {RUBY_B#Romance Titan}Mnestia{RUBY_E#}'s remaining divine mind and bears the responsibility of guarding the Coreflame.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Legend has it that someone can only pass the trial of the butterfly by proving they possess pure and unselfish love within their heart. Only then can they awaken the Great Tree to open up the path to meet {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: But how are we... going to prove it?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Will telling the Titan "I love you" work? Mem is good at doing that!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Sorry, but even I don't know how... After all, this is a secret among secrets that only a select few in the entire Grove and even Amphoreus know.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Rather than worry about this, Lady Trianne, did the golden thread react to anything around here?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Umm, no. That unknown thing seems to be even farther ahead and higher up.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Uhhh, but... Isn't that a dead end up ahead?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Perhaps we can try again... Let's see if the butterfly will still react to the Golden Bough of Vows despite having dissipated.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: If it's indeed the token mentioned in the legends, there should be a reaction.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Lady Trianne, what exactly happened just now?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Trianne and Memmy were looking around to see if there were any mechanisms nearby...
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: But just as they went to take a closer look at that big piece of amber, they were surrounded!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: ...I see.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let's get a move on. The orbs belonging to {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}'s priests should be nearby... Hopefully, they'll be of some use.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I'll... leave it in your capable hands...!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Before I'm cooked... let me first think about how to apologize... *sniffle*
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Waaaah... Little Gray, Little Cas! It's bad... It's very bad!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Don't worry, friend... I'm fine...! I just feel... a little warm...!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: But... It would be best if you could keep me from becoming a snack for these little things...!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Sorry, I shouldn't have called you guys "little things"...!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Well done, friend!}Bloop bloop bloop...{RUBY_E#}
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: {RUBY_B#It feels so much cooler now!}Bloop bloop bloop bloop...{RUBY_E#}
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: It's connected! Let's hurry! Memmy is already bouncing around due to the heat!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: N—No... This is a sweet little dance to express my apologies...!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: So warm... much comfort...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Oh no, I'm starting to smell something delicious.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Haha... That must be because I can't help giving off an irresistible charm.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Precision, and grace. That did not take much effort... Was this supposed to be a challenge?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: It's all right! Trianne only just flew down.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: ...A remnant of {RUBY_B#Romance Titan}Mnestia{RUBY_E#}'s Coreflame.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: To get to the throne at the treetop, gather the embers before you with the Golden Bough of Vows and present it to the divine butterfly.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Whoa... Where did you come from!?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: You finally appeared... Lady Calypso.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Yes... It's been some time. The battle just now was a true delight, and I feel quite elated...
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: ...It seems like I'll really be able to rely on all of you to reclaim my true form.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: ...Lady Trianne, how does the golden thread react to her?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Mmm...
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: There's... no reaction at all.
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Hehe, obviously. After all, the fragment that you picked up just now is completely unrelated to me.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Alright, just do as I say. If you're able to pass the trial, I will tell you everything truthfully.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Another trial...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Come on, I hate people who don't finish their thoughts!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: But we have to go to the treetop to find Nax anyway, right?
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: I've got a hunch. Come, let's collect the embers and go confront her.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...Just kidding! I just wanted to marvel at how [Trailblazer] and Cas always manage to resolve crises so effortlessly.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: According to Calypso, we just have to "gather the embers before us with the Golden Bough of Vows"...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: How incredible...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Uhh, so... We just have to present it to the butterfly?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: *Titan's sad cries*
rows.speaker: Mnestia's Illusion

rows.speaker: Mnestia's Illusion

rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: It'll be fine. Let's just do as she says.

rows.text: *Titan's sad cries*
rows.speaker: Mnestia's Illusion

rows.text: Heh... All of you have indeed passed the trial.

rows.text: *Titan's sad cries*
rows.speaker: Mnestia's Illusion

rows.text: Hehe...

rows.text: If the west wind ever ends, let that be the place where we reunite.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Farewell... my love.

rows.text: Lady Calypso, this is...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Haha... It's nothing much.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Thank you so much for your help. Now it's time for me to fulfill my part of the promise.
rows.speaker: Calypso

rows.text: Well, in that case, I can start...
